India's REIT market expands, overtakes Hong Kong

India's Real Estate Investment Trusts (REITs) market has seen significant expansion, with investors able to acquire shares in publicly traded REITs or through mutual funds and ETFs for diversification. The market has overtaken Hong Kong to become the fourth-largest REIT market in Asia.
